basic_info.description: Spectacular retreat on peaceful tree-lined street in famed location! This home has it all: soaring ceilings, exposed brick, updated kitchen and bathroom, great storage and a deeded deck directly off the living space that leads to a gorgeous sun-drenched backyard oasis. Walk and bike everywhere including shops in the Haight, Falletti Foods, Divisadero corridor, the Panhandle and Buena Vista Park. Ideal starter home or pied a terre. Do not miss this opportunity!
